scope: Measurement-only repair of the inconclusive v2 Linux attempt. It does not modify the frozen profile, policy, candidate, receipt, exact graph, certificate, source material, Windows evidence bundle, or either preserved prior attempt.

repair.defect: The v2 gate treated every raw ::/0 row in /proc/net/ipv6_route as usable egress and did not persist the initial network snapshot before asserting. Linux may represent a non-forwarding unreachable default sentinel as ::/0.
repair.authoritative_route_source: local iproute2 JSON from ip -j -4/-6 route show default
unchanged_gates: socket.if_nameindex() and /proc/net/dev each report only loopback
no usable IPv4 or IPv6 forwarding default route
two active numeric-address IPv4 egress probes fail for explicit network-unreachable reasons before and after trusted execution
all trusted descendants execute inside the unshared network and PID namespaces
all scientific receipt fields except environment match the frozen Windows reference

online_provisioning: instantiate and precompile the frozen Julia environment
capture a hash-bound v3 provisioning manifest including local iproute2 executable identity
egress_denied_execution: enter a fresh Linux network namespace
persist the initial network snapshot before any isolation assertion
require both namespace-aware interface censuses to report only loopback
require no usable forwarding default route while retaining any explicit non-forwarding sentinel as evidence
require two active numeric-address IPv4 TCP probes to fail for explicit network-unreachable reasons
verify unchanged pre-isolation provisioning-manifest hashes and timestamp
execute Python, Julia/Nemo, Lean, and all 373 mandatory challenges
persist and validate the final network snapshot
freeze and structurally replay the Linux evidence bundle
compare all non-environment receipt fields with the frozen Windows reference

must_match_exactly: all output verification classes and evidence bindings
allowed_to_differ: verification receipt hash induced solely by environment metadata

result_retention: Every attempted run preserves pre-assertion network snapshots, logs, provisioning evidence, and exit disposition. A failed or inconclusive attempt cannot be promoted and is never replaced in place by a retry.
evidence_status: No v3 Linux result is earned until this workflow completes successfully, satisfies every linked acceptance criterion, and its result artifact is preserved and reviewed.
